svg.title: Epistemic games categorical case heatmap
svg.desc: All selected epistemic-games cases are shown by their exact scenario, evidence, prior, presentation, and framing settings. The outcome heatmap is all pass under behavioral-reference judging; factor values are categories, not easy-medium-hard levels.
svg.text: These factors use categorical values, not easy/medium/hard levels.
